rows.pred_sql:

  SELECT
    se.semester_id,
    sem.semester_name AS semester,
    se.student_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY se.semester_id, se.student_id) AS student_registrations_per_student,

  FROM Student_Enrolment se
  JOIN Semesters sem ON se.semester_id = sem.semester_id
),

  SELECT

    semester,

JOIN max_per_semester m
  ON ec.semester_id = m.semester_id
